_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. IMPORTANT: recovered a publish gap first — the 2026-09-14 run's commits had never reached main (stuck on the generated branch claude/brave-carson-900ltz, the same failure mode as the 2026-08-10 incident documented in AGENT_PROMPT.md); this run's checkout already had them, so this run's changes were made on top and the publish below pushes both weeks' work to main together. No new opportunities founded this run (every promising lead traced back to evidence already in the catalog, or fell outside the 12-month recency window, or lacked disclosed methodology). Two opportunities gained new corroborating evidence without score changes: coding-productivity-gains-attenuate-at-shipping (added a July 2026 arXiv study of Microsoft's internal command-line-AI-coding-agent rollout, ~24% sustained pull-request-merge lift across tens of thousands of engineers over 4 months — corroborates, does not contradict, the existing NBER attenuation-cascade finding; score unchanged at 4) and flatter-orgs-wider-spans-of-control (added PwC's Jan 2026 'No more pyramids' framework piece as a fourth independent institution; score unchanged at 3). Red-teamed all ten evidenceScore>=4 opportunities; no new threshold-clearing contradictions found (a BCG 'centralized AI hub' piece and further entry-level-contraction corroboration were both considered and explicitly not added — see findings log for why). Under-covered roles (Product Management 1, QA/Test Engineering 2, Data Engineering 3, Help Desk/IT Support 3) searched again with dedicated queries; no admissible new evidence found in any of the four. Census BTOS and MIT CISR (priority sources) searched; both leads found were already in the trail. BLS (consecutiveEmptyRuns 7) and NBER (9) remain above the dead-source threshold but continue to surface directly relevant material that turns out already-captured — flagged for a more targeted deeper pass next run rather than as likely-dead sources. PwC and arXiv each yielded new admissible findings this run and reset to 0.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
